acceptance_criteria: REQ-cli-060 and REQ-history-013 (new) and REQ-cli-057 (modified): a lifecycle record of the active session's change written outside Chough is recorded once as a direct-native-write history event, with its files and states, at the next successful stage move; Chough's own change steps are never flagged because they update an untracked baseline; first sight flags nothing; next and status show pending writes and change nothing; nothing is recorded in the check-to-finalize window; a finding never refuses. The change log names the oldest Chough that reads the event. Seven tests in tests/direct_writes.rs and the modified change-steps test fail first, each mutant in testing.md fails one, and fledge run linux-verify passes.

answers.constraints: Issue #183, slice 3 of Chough drives SpecSync; slice order approved by Leif (relayed by the orc). DRIVE-21; DRIVE-4 (nothing written between check --commit and finalize, so findings wait for a stage move); DRIVE-2 (no new native read); DRIVE-12 (append-only events). Modifies REQ-cli-057 for the untracked baseline only. History compatibility: older Chough refuses the new kind, and the change log names the oldest reader. IDs REQ-cli-060 and REQ-history-013, announced to t27. Lesson: merge main before review and rebuild the vault.
